title: EffectDescriptor
description: Minimal durable v3.1 effect descriptor contract.

category.description: Optional human-facing category label for catalogs and docs.

cellAccess.description: Cell channels the effect may read or write.

domain.description: Broad execution domain for planning and capability grouping.

scopeSupport.description: Scope kinds and spaces this effect supports.

version.description: Descriptor version string owned by the effect family.

writeSupport.description: Cell and role write policies this effect supports.

CellAccess.description: Cell channels an effect may read or write.

reads.description: Cell channels the effect may inspect.

writes.description: Cell channels the effect may write.

CellChannel.description: Canonical channels that make up a cell write.

oneOf.description: Glyph character channel.
Foreground color channel.
Background color channel.
Text modifier channel.
Modifier alpha channel.
Semantic role channel. Role writes are governed by role policy.

CellWritePolicy.description: Policy for how a cell write updates cell channels.

oneOf.description: Write the cell exactly, including transparent empty cells.
Skip only transparent empty cell writes, preserving destination cell and role.

CoordinateSpace.description: Coordinate space used by geometry scopes.

oneOf.description: Destination-local coordinates. This is the Phase A/B default.
Sampled-source local coordinates. Present to make the contract explicit.

EffectCompletion.description: Minimal completion category for descriptor lifecycle metadata.

oneOf.description: The effect does not naturally complete on its own.
The effect completes during the same evaluation step.
The effect completes after a bounded duration.
The effect eventually completes, but the bound is not part of E1.
Completion is controlled by an external host signal.

EffectDomain.description: Broad execution role declared by an effect descriptor.

oneOf.description: Generates content cells without requiring existing source content.
Transforms existing content while preserving its broad semantic role.
Shades individual cell visual channels.
Filters a complete frame or surface after content exists.
Changes which source coordinate a destination cell samples.
Produces or applies a mask for later stages.
Produces shadow-like support content or role tagging.
Runs after primary composition as a post-process.
Emits diagnostics or analysis without being a visual effect.

EffectLifecycle.description: Minimal lifecycle metadata declared by an effect descriptor.

completion.description: Completion category exposed to recipe and runtime planning.

deterministicWithSeed.description: Whether seeded execution is deterministic for the same inputs.

resettable.description: Whether the effect can be reset to its initial state.

seekable.description: Whether the effect can be sampled at an arbitrary timeline position.

RoleSpace.description: Role source used by role scopes.

oneOf.description: Role scopes inspect the sampled source role. This is the Phase A/B default.
Role scopes inspect the destination role before the write.

RoleWritePolicyKind.description: Payload-free role write policy kind used by descriptor support declarations.

oneOf.description: Descriptor may preserve destination roles.
Descriptor may copy sampled-source roles.
Descriptor may set an explicit role chosen by the operation.

ScopeKind.description: Scope shape a descriptor can explicitly support.

oneOf.description: Descriptor supports all-cell scopes.
Descriptor supports role-based scopes.
Descriptor supports rectangular geometry scopes.
Descriptor supports row range geometry scopes.
Descriptor supports column range geometry scopes.

ScopeSupport.description: Scope shapes and evaluation spaces an effect descriptor supports.

coordinateSpaces.description: Supported coordinate spaces for geometry scopes.

roleSpaces.description: Supported role spaces for role scopes.

WriteSupport.description: Cell and role write policies an effect descriptor supports.
